newsitem.title: USA: Clint Eastwood settles suit with ex-lover.
newsitem.headline: Clint Eastwood settles suit with ex-lover.

text.p: Clint Eastwood and his ex-lover Sondra Locke have reached an agreement in which the movie star will pay her an undisclosed amount to settle her civil suit claiming Eastwood sabotaged her screen career, attorneys said Tuesday.
The settlement was announced minutes before the jury was scheduled to continue its deliberations in the suit in which Locke was seeking $2.5 million from Eastwood.

Eastwood's lawyer Raymond Fisher told reporters the movie star was pleased with the settlement reached over the weekend. He declined to say how much Eastwood would pay Locke, the woman he lived with for 13 years.
One juror, Robert Campbell, told Reuters the panel, which began deliberations Friday, had been ready to find in favor of Locke by a 10-2 vote.
They were split mostly on the amount of damages. "The big bucks were going to come from the damage to reputation and the emotional distress," Campbell said.
Locke contended that her film-directing deal with Warner Bros. was sabotaged by Eastwood who made a secret deal with the studio to reimburse it for any losses it made on her projects.
